title: H1: evening Coconala re-scan (ids > last screened); send under PG-1 (widened lane, ≤5/day)
detail: Scan new public requests (https://coconala.com/requests?recruiting=true&sort=new) since the last screened id (5320062 as of 10/11 19:03; the 10:00 h1-coconala-scan-1012 will advance it) under the WIDENED lane (PROPOSAL_KIT §2/§2.5). Send under PG-1 when conditions 1-7 hold (log each). Cap ≤5/day combined with CrowdWorks. Tip: list via in-page fetch + DOMParser (use textContent, not innerText) and fetch /requests/<id> in-page. Respect the 10/12 Coconala kill-check decision if the Founder fires it. On done: create the next evening scan (id h1-coconala-scan-<MMDD>pm).
acceptance: screen appended; each send logged with --grant PG-1; next evening scan task created
